validation.diagram_visual_check: MODEL_VISUAL_ONLY; six crops inspected; clipped caption corrected in v2
validation.validation_kind: Synthetic regression plus actual local source-bound candidate consumption, not human or platform approval

limitations: Five source-bound candidates do not establish a complete lesson denominator or unattended OCR.
Raw OCR variants and model visual source revisions remain distinct; superscripts, fractions and diagram noise still require review.
Question types are not inferred from MCQ parser success/failure; original warnings are retained.
The candidate checker deterministically rebuilds the projection using the same implementation; it is not independent human review.
Private candidates use absolute local file references and are not relocatable or runtime writer payloads.
Skipped full-suite checks require external source/ignored local artifacts not copied into the repository.
Original full run is not green: two existing async test setups hit WinError 10013 before test bodies; all ten tests in that unchanged group passed one isolated recheck. Original errors are retained.
No private source images, real question text, native responses, credentials or browser profiles are included in this public summary.
